about: Public corrections log, shown on how-we-work.html. Newest first. Add an entry whenever an alert, date or answer we showed was wrong.

corrections.what: The "alerts updated" date and the date on device pages showed the next day in the evening.
corrections.fix: Dates now follow the clock on your phone, and the pages use Eastern time. Alert content was not affected.

corrections.what: The Do now and This week counters still counted alerts you had marked done, and a done mark on one person's list showed on everyone's.
corrections.fix: Counters now skip items you marked done, and each person's marks are kept separately. Alert content was not affected.
